note: Hand-derived from the three production writers' templates and the predicate registration in go/internal/storage/cypher/edge/materialized/predicate_families.go (#8358, route 2 of the #6228 verdict's cloud_resource follow-up). Each writer MATCHes two :CloudResource endpoints by uid and MERGEs (source)-[rel:%s]->(target) with NO relationship property map, so edges key on (type, source uid, target uid) alone and there is no identity block. The %s is the writer's exported prefix const prepended to the row's relationship_type (AWSRelationshipCypherTypePrefix, GCPRelationshipCypherTypePrefix, AzureRelationshipCypherTypePrefix) — the statement-metadata labels (AWS_RELATIONSHIP, GCP_RELATIONSHIP, AZURE_RELATIONSHIP) never reach the graph. Endpoint ids are reducer cloudjoin.CloudResourceUID values = facts.StableID over (account, region, resource_type, resource_id) of the Odù's own facts: AWS over (123456789012, us-east-1, type, id) for (aws_lambda_function, eshu-fixture-fn), (aws_iam_role, eshu-fixture-fn-role), (aws_ec2_subnet, subnet-eshufixt1); GCP over (eshu-fixture-project, us-central1-a, asset_type, full_resource_name); Azure over (eshu-fixture-subscription, eastus, resource_type, normalized ARM id). Exactly four edges: two AWS verbs off one source (the duplicate lambda_function_uses_execution_role fact dedups; the never-scanned subnet target and the self-loop produce nothing, and a regression fabricating endpoints or admitting self-loops would break this set), one GCP supported relationship (the partial and the unsupported-target relationships produce nothing), one Azure managed_by (the depends_on verb is screened out by Azure's closed vocabulary). evidence_source and resolution_mode (and support_state where the GCP/Azure templates SET it) are asserted as mutable properties: evidence_source is the compile-time handler constant the retract scopes by, so a writer that stopped stamping it must fail here and on the live assert, not only when the next generation's retract silently reaps nothing. scope_id and generation_id are per-run intent values, so no static set can pin them; the writer unit tests cover their stamping.
